findings.detail: evalsets monotonicity gate enforces the full v1 ladder (all steps, tol 1e-06). B2-v42 rises +5.5e-05 (lad-0000/0002-0005) and +1.38e-04 (lad-0001/0006) exactly on the 0.99->0.95 razor-zone-crossing step; all outside-zone steps are flat (delta 0.0). The ratified sanity v2 zoning (addendum 5b 7.3, gate_contract sanity_v2.monotonicity_v2.rule: 'steps 1.0 -> 0.99 -> 0.95 are not checked') exempts these steps; magnitude is Platt/leaf quantization noise deep inside the dup band (P >= 0.995 on every rung). Follow-up: port the zoned rule into the evalsets runner (contract-wave, not a threshold change).

release-v2 near-identity-twin probe near-0009 scores P(dup)=0.0100 (floor requires >= 0.5; 17/18 probes pass, min of class). Geometry: cos 0.99, char5_jaccard 0.9018, char5_containment 0.9484, tag_jaccard 1.0, zero len-deltas, type/lang match. B1 passes all 18. Reads as side-effect of the C1 rebalance: same-length T3 fact-edit negatives (char5_cont >= 0.9764, cos 0.99 -> NOT dup) sharpened the high-overlap boundary into the near-identity cloud at char5 ~ 0.90. Corridor to B1 still holds (17/18 vs 18/18 within CI95 for n=18). Watchlist for the next corpus/weights iteration and for B0 field telemetry; not part of the ratified ADOPT criteria (prereg 4 lists self_pair/monotonicity/symmetry invariants and B1-corridors).
